sin.name: interface-overlap
sin.description: An interface repeats the signatures of a contract it can reuse.
sin.rule: Use the accessible contract for identical signatures. Extend it to add the remaining signatures.
sin.suggestion: Check that the contracts promise the same behaviour before reusing the existing one.

true: if it promises the same behaviour.

advice: and declare only the added methods if the shared methods promise the same behaviour.

layers.description: The layers the project declares under configure, each to the layers it may use.

publicContracts.description: The types the project publishes as contracts, from configure's public contracts.
